text.en: This is the SEE Grade Increment 2082 (2026 AD) question paper for Computer Science, Optional Second subject, paper code GI-3031. CLS
CALL SERIES
END

SUB SERIES
FOR J = 5 TO 1 STEP -1
    FOR I = 1 TO J
        PRINT I;
    NEXT I
    PRINT
NEXT J
END SUB

REM to add more data in sequential data file
Open "REC. DAT" FOR OUTPUT AS #1
DO
    INPUT "Enter Name"; N$
    INPUT "Enter Address"; A$
    INPUT "Enter class with section"; C$
    INPUT "Enter Roll no."; RN
    INPUT #2, N$, A$, C$, RN
    INPUT "Do you want to continue"; CH$
LOOP WHILE UCASE$(CH$) = "Y"
CLOSE
END

items.code:
DECLARE FUNCTION SUM (N)
CLS
A = 1234
Y = SUM (A)
PRINT "Sum of individual digits"; Y
END

FUNCTION SUM (N)
    WHILE N<>0
        D = N MOD 10
        S = S+D
        N = INT (N/10)
    WEND
    SUM = S
END FUNCTION
